params.body:
The Studio side of the site pull request with the same branch name (`workbench/changes-2026-11-26` on schoutteet).

## Settings: company details
- `siteSettings` is titled "Bedrijfsgegevens en openingsuren" and has two groups.
- A new `company` object holds the name, tagline (per language), street, postal code, city, country (per language), phone, fax, e-mail and WhatsApp.
- Phone is required and checked: it must be international, or a Belgian number with a leading 0. `schemaTypes/phone.ts` uses the same E.164 rule as the site and is tested in `tests/phone.test.ts`.
- The preview shows the phone with its `tel:` form.
- The opening hours and their note move to the "Openingsuren" group.

## Services: photo gallery
- `service.photos` is an array of images with alt text per language, shown as a gallery on the services page.
- The old single `service.image` stays visible as "Oude foto" while it holds a photo, so nothing is lost before the migration script moves it into `photos`.
- `steps` ("Zo verloopt het") is hidden and has no rules any more (it required exactly three), so existing steps stay in the data without blocking a publish.

## Sell page
- `sellPage.checklist` is the list of what helps to value a vehicle, shown beside the call, mail and WhatsApp buttons.
- `steps` is hidden, without rules.
- The singleton and the service route are called "Voertuig verkopen", as on the site.

`CONTRACT.md` describes the new fields.

## Checks
- vitest: 16 passed.
- tsc, eslint and `sanity build` pass.

## After merge
Deploy the Studio, then run the three Sanity scripts described in the site pull request.
params.title: Company details, service photo gallery and sell-page checklist
